page.Слева внизу, в разделе «Другое», нажмите: At the bottom left, in the “Other” section, click API platform.
page.Откроется «perplexity api platform». Сна: “perplexity api platform” opens. First top up the balance: Add credits — a few dollars
page.нескольких долларов. Потом нажмите <b>«С: are enough to start. Then click Create API key (or API keys on the left → create).
page.Появится ключ — длинная строка, начинает: The key appears: a long string starting with pplx-. Copy it with the copy button
page.или выделите мышкой и нажмите <kbd>Ctrl<: or select it with the mouse and press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>. The key is shown only once: if you lose it, create a new one.
page.Помощник необязательный: программа работ: The helper is optional: the program works without it. With it, starting a search and screening articles is faster.
page.Тема своими словами → слова для поиска.<: Topic in your own words → search words. Describe the topic as you would to a friend: the AI picks English terms and synonyms, and the program builds queries for Scopus, Web of Science and OpenAlex from them. The button is in the «🔎 Get a DOI list» window.
page.Предотбор статей.</b> ИИ читает аннотаци: Article pre-screening. The AI reads the abstracts and advises: fits, questionable or does not fit, with a reason. The decision is still yours. The button is in the «📝 Screen articles» window.
page.Сколько стоит</b> Perplexity списывает д: What it costs Perplexity charges your API balance for every request: picking words costs less than a cent, pre-screening a hundred articles a few cents. The program shows how much was spent. None of this money goes to the author.
page.Как оплатить</b> Счёт API пополняется ка: How to pay The API balance is topped up with a card of a foreign bank or with Apple Pay. Perplexity does not accept Russian cards.
page.Что уходит в Perplexity</b> Только тема: What goes to Perplexity Only the topic and the titles with abstracts of the articles. The key is stored only on this computer. Do not show the key to anyone: it spends your money.
page.Тема своими словами</b> — ИИ подберёт ан: Topic in your own words — the AI picks English words and synonyms, the program builds the queries from them.
page.ИИ-помощник не подключён: с ним ИИ сам п: The AI helper is not connected: with it, the AI reads the abstracts itself and suggests which articles fit.
page.Кнопка GitHub откроет страницу с готовым: The GitHub button opens a page with the text filled in — just click «Create» / «Submit new issue» (a free GitHub account is needed). No account? Copy the report and send it to the program's chat.
page.Чат программы: вопросы, советы, новости: The program's chat: questions, tips, news
page.💬 Проще всего — спросить в чате программ: 💬 The easiest way is to ask in the program's chat — the author and other users answer there:
page.Вопросы, советы и новости программы. Отв: Questions, tips and news about the program. The author and other users answer.
